findings.title: Scaled rank-revealing least squares closes scale and near-collinearity failures
findings.formula_or_invariant: Nonzero column rescaling preserves rank and fitted values after reciprocal coefficient mapping; full-rank ill-conditioned designs must use a rank-revealing solve.
affected_cases: full-rank scaled or near-collinear public inputs
reproduction_steps: Fit the deterministic two-column no-constant probe before and after multiplying both regressors by 1e-8.
Compare fitted values and reciprocally rescaled coefficients; run the rank and covariance tests in tests/test_ols.py.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. Column scaling plus NumPy lstsq/SVD is scale-invariant in the probe and rejects detected rank deficiency explicitly.
